messages:
morgan: Heads-up — planning phased rollout for structured-output / function-calling today. Proposal: enable feature_flag "so_v2_client_behavior" in hosted API for 5% canary at 10:00 PT, 25% at 13:00 PT, then 100% tomorrow. Need SDK behavior lock and explicit compatibility mode. Ping owners.

alejandra: +1. Do we have a client toggle name and default behavior? Also need a compatibility shim for older SDKs.

taylan: Suggested flag: `so_client_compat_mode` with values "disabled|compat|strict". Default = "compat" for now. SDKs should default to compat and opt-in to strict.

sam: +1. Can we add automatic fallback to text-only model when structured output fails? Add a router guardrail so apps don't break.

morgan: yes — router will fallback to "text-backcompat" variant if response not parseable. We'll emit metric `so_parse_fail` and auto-disable for that user after 3 consecutive parse failures.

priya: Will need telemetry hooks in SDK: `so_parse_fail` + `so_invocations`. I'll add to SDK PR. Also need docs update for `response_format` param.

docs-bot: FYI, updating docs page: /docs/api/structured-output with new examples. Will link PR when ready.

taylan: quick rollout config sketch: 

```json
{
  "flag": "so_v2_client_behavior",
  "audience": [{"type":"percent","value":5},{"type":"percent","value":25}],
  "stages": ["canary","ramp"],
  "fallback": "text-backcompat"
}
```

sam: small ask — send an opt-out list for enterprise customers who require strict old behavior. We must exclude Dedicated/private deployments from percent enrollments.

morgan: noted. @alejandra can you own enterprise opt-out list and ensure dedicated customers are excluded from percent joins?

alejandra: yes, will update gating rules. Also will add audit log entry for any flag changes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: toggle changes should be declared in #eng-oncall 15m before start.

morgan: copying schedule: 10:00 PT - 5% canary hosted, 13:00 PT - 25% ramp, 16:00 PT - pause + review, 18:00 PT - 50% if metrics look good, next day - 100%. Owners: rollout=morgan, SDK=priya, router=sam, enterprise=alejandra, docs=docs-bot.

priya: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/412 — adds telemetry and `response_format` param.

morgan: remind eng-runtime to instrument `so_parse_fail` and token-level latency. @taylan can you coordinate with eng-runtime?

taylan: will file runtime ticket after lunch. tracking: RT-4523.

sam: I'll add fallback routing and canary scoring to router. quick QA: what are SLOs for parse latency? need numbers.

morgan: target < 150ms extra parse overhead p95. If exceeded, abort ramp.

alejandra: Also adding one more guardrail: if customer-reported regression rate increases >0.5% over baseline in canary, rollback.

priya: LGTM. Will monitor telemetry dashboards and add alert at 0.2% early warning.

deploy-bot: canary schedule created: job 78921. First stage pending.

morgan: OK let's proceed. please ack when you have PRs and dashboards linked in thread. :thumbsup:
